title: Z.E.R.O. protocol 5
description: One JSON object a line over the server's Unix socket (~/.zero/run/zero.sock; `zero server start --json` names it, starting the server when none answers): a request, then its reply; session/watch and session/list with watch stream events. Each request names its message in `message` and its protocol in `protocol`; a message marked x-changes carries an `id` the sender picks, run once. Where the socket can't tell who connects, `token` carries the token file's text.
